zin_concord_add_own_loyalty = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			zin_aenor_is_concord_dominion = yes
		}
		set_temp_variable = { zin_arg_value = zin_arg_value }
		zin_aenor_add_concord_loyalty = yes
	}
}

# Arguments: zin_arg_charter (keyword old 0, golden 1, shield 2, free 3, wall 4).
zin_concord_petition_charter = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			zin_aenor_is_concord_dominion = yes
		}
		set_variable = { zin_concord_petition_code = zin_arg_charter }
		if = {
			limit = {
				zin_concord_charter_grantable = yes
			}
			OVERLORD = {
				country_event = zin_shared_concord_dominions.1
			}
		}
		else = {
			OVERLORD = {
				country_event = zin_shared_concord_dominions.6
			}
		}
	}
}

# Arguments: zin_arg_camp (keyword court 1, faithful 2, dominions 3, host 4); zin_arg_value (number).
zin_concord_back_camp = {
	# zin_arg_camp and zin_arg_value stay set for zin_aenor_add_camp_support.
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_global_flag = zin_golden_king_dead
			NOT = { has_global_flag = zin_eindil_crowned }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				is_subject = yes
				OVERLORD = { zin_aenor_is_realm = yes }
			}
			OVERLORD = { zin_aenor_add_camp_support = yes }
		}
		else = {
			zin_aenor_event_for_parim = yes
			if = {
				limit = { has_event_target = zin_aenor_parim_realm }
				event_target:zin_aenor_parim_realm = { zin_aenor_add_camp_support = yes }
			}
		}
	}
}

	random_country = {
		limit = {

		}
		add_to_faction = ROOT

zin_concord_grant_petition = {
	FROM = {
		set_temp_variable = { zin_arg_charter = zin_concord_petition_code }
		zin_aenor_set_charter = yes
		set_temp_variable = { zin_arg_value = 10 }
		zin_concord_add_own_loyalty = yes
		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { zin_concord_petition_code = 1 }
			}
			set_temp_variable = { zin_arg_value = 3 }
			zin_concord_add_own_loyalty = yes
		}
		set_country_flag = {
			flag = zin_concord_charter_recent
			days = 180
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			zin_concord_petition_is_golden = yes
		}
		add_political_power = 50
		set_temp_variable = { zin_arg_value = 2 }
		zin_aenor_add_court_corruption = yes
	}
}

zin_concord_admit_dominion = {
	puppet = FROM
	set_autonomy = {
		target = FROM
		autonomy_state = zin_autonomy_chartered_dominion
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			is_faction_leader = yes
		}
		add_to_faction = FROM
	}
	FROM = {
		set_temp_variable = { zin_arg_charter = 0 }
		zin_aenor_set_charter = yes
		set_variable = { zin_concord_loyalty = 60 }
	}
